## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `d4f56f4a37f8141b250d60ab630bb87a5f4a2724` · 2026-11-24T21:47Z

Requested by zone a4-U for card #36911 (route A, 7140314619).

Delivered and correct: the shared row menu asks the unchanged `useRowApprovalLocks` through `onActionsDemand` — one deduped read per page, none on first paint; Edit is hidden only when the read answered locked (`isLocked(id, null)`, so the `approval_status` column never stands in); 501, a null entry, a failed or not-yet-asked read leave the menu as it was; Delete stays (the server deletes a locked record and cancels its request, #13568). The related tab and ObjectGrid's phone card face go through the same path. `resolveObjectGridActionsColumn`, `RowApprovalLocks` and the hook are not exported (plugin-grid exports `.` and `./style.css` only). The two out-of-surface test fakes answer "unlocked" for every id — the same as before the PR — with no assertion changed: accepted. The lock-less local type-check is answered by green CI. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch: right. Check-runs: 40 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed. K: 12.

S1 (should-fix) — "Delete stays on any answered lock" (`objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` ~101-120 and the changeset) holds only for a record held by its own approval. Once #37041 makes the batch read report the lines of a held master as locked, the menu would hide Edit but still offer Delete, which the server refuses. Not a regression today. Fix: narrow the code comment and the changeset to "held by its own approval", and the zone comments on #37041 that its answer must tell "held itself" from "master held" (or the menu must also hide Delete on such lines).
S2 (should-fix) — the list-page path has no pin: there the actions come from the single-row selection bar (Edit as a bar button, `SelectionBar.tsx`) and the context menu, not a ⋮ column. Add a pin that selects the locked row in the list-page scope and asserts the bar shows no Edit and still shows Delete; ablate the hide → red.

Nits (zone's discretion): N1 pin the race (hold the lock read, open the menu, Edit shows, resolve, Edit disappears); N2 a second ablation `null` → `row` at the `isLocked` call (test ~199 red); N3 the ⋮ column vanishes when every row is locked and Delete is not offered (same as the record verdict, note only); N4 on 501 with `approval_status` pending the cell is read-only while the menu offers Edit — deliberate, info; N5 lock answers can go stale while the grid stays mounted (inherited) — possible follow-up; N6 staged click-to-edit and bulk Change owner do not read the lock — pre-existing.

Delta L1 on the new head.
